name: vortaq
description: Vortaq: independent, open-source desktop database client (connections, object explorer, query editor, backups and automation).
author: Y0rshB3

scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:ext
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/seed-screenshots.mjs && npm run build && VORTAQ_USER_DATA=${VORTAQ_SHOTS_PROFILE:-${ELECTRONDB_SHOTS_PROFILE:-${NAVIDOG_SHOTS_PROFILE:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vortaq-shots/profile}}} VORTAQ_PLAIN_SECRETS=1 VORTAQ_AI_FIXTURE=1 VORTAQ_NAVICAT_CANDIDATES=${VORTAQ_NAVICAT_CANDIDATES:-tests/fixtures/navicat} VORTAQ_UPDATES_FIXTURE=${VORTAQ_UPDATES_FIXTURE:-tests/fixtures/updates/latest-release.json} VORTAQ_IMPORT_HOME=${VORTAQ_IMPORT_HOME:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vortaq-shots/import-home} VORTAQ_IMPORT_PICK=${VORTAQ_IMPORT_PICK:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vortaq-shots/import/vortaq_shots_import.sql} VORTAQ_WHATS_NEW_FROM=${VORTAQ_WHATS_NEW_FROM:-0.1.2} VORTAQ_WHATS_NEW_VERSION=${VORTAQ_WHATS_NEW_VERSION:-0.1.4} VORTAQ_SCREENSHOTS=${VORTAQ_SHOTS_DIR:-${ELECTRONDB_SHOTS_DIR:-${NAVIDOG_SHOTS_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vortaq-shots}}} npx electron .
